name: clipugc
description: ClipUGC skills for Claude Code: a UGC video director (reaction archetypes, hook formulas, casting, prompt library), a persona-account runner for ongoing AI creator accounts (persona definition, content pillars, next-post loop, grid composition), plus the full CLI: create AI characters, generate photorealistic looks, produce silent-reaction video clips, copy a movement from a reference video on two engines, put your AI influencer into a video you filmed, and add app screen recordings to make ready-to-post UGC videos. New: story-runner, ongoing story series where an AI character lives a continuing life in short talking episodes, each picking up from the previous episode’s last frame.
